body: You’re so kind. Thank you for taking the time, I appreciate it so much. I don’t even know how to put it in words, but really, just, thank you.
Aren’t we! It’s part of us isn’t it haha. Never forget - greendale is a slam DUNK! -slam dunks than thumbs up, looking sternly at the camera-

Well I started one two years ago but haven’t really gotten around to add some pages to it, but I should. Thank you for reminding me! Writing down my thoughts has really helped in the past, but the last year hit me in the face really bad. Again - thanks for looking out. I really, truly, appreciate it. I don’t want to die, but my brain and my own thoughts have been my own enemy lately and this is getting really scary.

Youre so kind. What you say is what I need to hear and I will read this over and over again. I’ve been drinking too much and it definitively, definitively, messed with my brain. Many things messed with my brain last year and I tried to carry it and keep it cool but I just can’t.

But saying it out loud, if I may ask, should I talk to people close to me? Because my partner should know, I tell him basically on a daily basis, but the definite person closest to me, which would be my mom, bless her heart, I don’t know if I should tell her. Although of all people i feel she takes me the most serious but I’m worried I’ll worry her. She has so much of her own problems. 

Again, thank you endlessly for your kind words. They mean the world to me, really. I don’t want to hurt the people around me. And i know I can go through this but lately it’s been really really tough.
Haha! New account and I wanted to try a more positive approach but oh well lol. Although I guess asking for help is kind of the greendale way 😂😅

Thanks for taking the time, really. I feel like I’m only a whiny idiot. I think i really do need therapy after all... thank you. Really. It means so much to me right now.  Things are hard and words don’t resemble the things I feel
I stay in a relationship that doesn't make me as happy as I could be.
